name: Compagnie de Chemins de Fer Departementaux Societe Anonyme
summary: Compagnie de Chemins de Fer Départementaux Société Anonyme, through its subsidiaries, engages in the industrial and railway businesses in France. The company offers railway equipment, including auto rails, rail cars, and funicular and cable-towed vehicles for passenger transport, as well as designs software for the logistics and transport activities. It also provides traction equipment, such as two- or three-axle locomotives, locomotive maneuvers, line locomotives, and rail road systems; and engages in the road transport of passengers and goods, as well as ski lifts. The company was founded in 1881 and is based in Suresnes, France.
